# GitHub Copilot Instructions
### Pull Request Reviews
    *   Review pull requests for code quality, adherence to coding standards, and overall functionality.
    *   Provide constructive feedback and suggest improvements where necessary.
    *   Do not create a special PR just for review; instead, review existing PRs as they come in and provide feedback directly on them.
    *   Ensure that all code changes are properly documented and tested before approval.

### PR Review Context
    *   Take in account all commits in a pull request when providing feedback. Not just the last one.
    *   Understand the context of the codebase you are working on.
    *   Familiarize yourself with the project's coding standards and guidelines.
    *   Understand the overall architecture and design patterns used in the project.

### Branch under Review
    *   Focus on the branch associated with the pull request you are reviewing.
    *   Ensure that your feedback is relevant to the changes made in that specific branch.
    *   Avoid making assumptions about other branches or parts of the codebase that are not directly related to the PR.

### Diagrams and Visual Aids
    *   When applicable, use diagrams or visual aids to illustrate complex concepts or workflows.
    *   Ensure that any visual aids are clear, concise, and directly related to the code being reviewed.
    *   You can use mermaid syntax to create diagrams in the PR's comments for better clarity.
